acceptance_predicates.description: Omitted channel selection resolves to dev and records current ASB/TUI provenance.
A fresh clone installs and consumes the exact published ASB/TUI artifacts through wizard, benchmark, recording, offline replay, comparison, and rollback.
Missing development credentials, signatures, and key management produce visible warnings only.
Human and JSON receipts identify exact tested heads, artifact digests, and hosted checks.

definition_of_done: Fresh-clone downstream matrix passes on exact published artifacts.
Independent review confirms no gate weakening or credential leakage.

inputs.description: Exact ASB/TUI dev-channel artifacts and provenance manifests.

outputs.description: Release, install, journey, rollback, and downstream-consumption receipt.

gates.description: A fresh clone completes the documented install-to-comparison journey using the published dev artifacts.
